Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks · Body, health & movement

rub with oil verb

also oil, anoint, oiling, grease, grease job, lubrication, lubricate

classical

perungō, perungere

verb, third conjugation

Other words

  • 1ūnxī, ūnctum, ūnctiō: long u before -nx-, -nct- (Lewis & Short leaves it unmarked). A hidden quantity: the vowel before -nct- and -nx- is long. Ruling: Macrons are spelling.

    ungō1 (unguō), ungere, ūnxī, ūnctum

    verb, third conjugation · classical · Traupman 216: grease; Traupman 323

  • ūnctiō1, ūnctiōnis f. — oiling

    noun, third declension · classical · Traupman 216, 217: grease job, lubrication

Examples

  • Pedēs tibi oleō ungam.

    I’ll rub your feet with oil.composed

  • ūnctiō autocīnētī

    a grease job (on a car)Traupman 323

See also baste, truss, oil, massage, ointment.
